video_title: Cynthia Cooper Wants Smoke With Maya Moore + Her Advice To Every Young Hooper

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper's advice on handling missed shots
quotes.excerpt: Stop putting so much pressure on yourself when you miss a shot. I missed plenty of shots.
quotes.quote: Stop putting so much pressure on yourself when you miss a shot. I missed plenty of shots and it didn't stop me from shooting. That's the only way you can get better, is not being afraid to fail.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the WNBA's growth and talent level
quotes.excerpt: Everybody's so excited around the W right now with all of the talent in the W.
quotes.quote: Everybody's so excited around the W right now with all of the talent in the W. When you see the Caitlin Clarks and you see the Asia Durrs and you see all of these players showing up and showing out every single game, I mean the level of the talent in the W is incredible.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the WNBA's financial growth and player respect
quotes.excerpt: This event, what the W is doing, did that mention that they're going to give us some money?
quotes.quote: I feel honored to be here, but I'm also honored by all of the talent that's in the W. This event, what the W is doing, did that mention that they're going to give us some money too? But that's because of the players and how much the players respect the legends, and so they really fought for this for us.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on the importance of WNBA legacy
quotes.excerpt: It's really about legacy. When you think about all of the success we had early on.
quotes.quote: It's really about legacy. When you think about all of the success we had early on and then time passes and people forget where we all came from and where we started. It's so great to see now we're getting a WNBA team back in the city of Houston. We'll also get a chance to do some special stuff like retire Tina Thompson, Hall of Famer and Sheryl Swoopes' jerseys.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper's advice to young players on failure and persistence
quotes.excerpt: Don't be afraid to fail. You got to fail to be successful.
quotes.quote: Don't be afraid to fail. You got to fail to be successful. Stop putting so much pressure on yourself when you miss a shot. I missed plenty of shots and it didn't stop me from shooting. I'm still shooting. That's first off. That's the only way you can get better, is not being afraid to fail. And then the second thing I would say is when obstacles come into your way, when stuff happens to you, I would say this: go to distance. Finish what you start. Be a finisher.

quotes.speaker: Cynthia Cooper
quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on Maya Moore's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: She's a great offensive player, but that she hangs her hat on her defense.
quotes.quote: Maya Moore. She's so great, y'all. But the thing I love about Maya Moore is she's a great offensive player, but that she hangs her hat on her defense, and I would love to take that hat off.

quotes.summary_phrase: Cynthia Cooper on Vicky Johnson's defensive tenacity
quotes.excerpt: Vicky Johnson because it didn't matter if I scored 40 points the night before or 10 points.
quotes.quote: Vicky Johnson because it didn't matter if I scored 40 points the night before or 10 points. She was going to bring her best defense and be physical with me, and while she was a little undersized, she was strong and quick, always trying to throw me off of my line to the basket.
